scripts.sa-keyfile: gcloud iam service-accounts keys create sa-key.json --iam-account=sac-commentary@vf-grp-mirep-dev-beta.iam.gserviceaccount.com
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c red,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && cd client && cp -r dist ../server/
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run dev:server
scripts.deploy:og: sh -c 'V=${1:-v1}; cd server && docker build -t sac-commenting-server:$V . && docker tag sac-commenting-server:$V europe-west1-docker.pkg.dev/vf-grp-aib-dev-dna-sbx-alpha/gcf-artifacts/sac-commenting-server:$V && docker push europe-west1-docker.pkg.dev/vf-grp-aib-dev-dna-sbx-alpha/gcf-artifacts/sac-commenting-server:$V' --
scripts.deploy: sh -c 'V=${1:-v1}; cd server && docker build -t sac-commenting:$V . && docker tag sac-commenting:$V gcr.io/vf-grp-gbissdbx-dev-1/sac-commenting:$V && docker push gcr.io/vf-grp-gbissdbx-dev-1/sac-commenting:$V' --
scripts.deploy:prod: sh -c 'V=${1:-v1}; npm run build && cd server && docker build -t sac-commenting:$V . && docker tag sac-commenting:$V europe-west3-docker.pkg.dev/vf-grp-mirep-dev-beta/misc/sac-commenting:$V && docker push europe-west3-docker.pkg.dev/vf-grp-mirep-dev-beta/misc/sac-commenting:$V' --
